proves.claim: pullboard status prints the clock line (items without owner+deadline, overdue with the oldest age, the pass age, stale after 3 minutes) from the stored clock.health document.

cli.io-status-clock.prints-invariant.why: Without it, the clock invariant would be computed but never visible in status.

proves.claim: With no stored clock document status prints 'clock: no pass yet', and status --json carries the stored document as clock, null when absent.

cli.io-status-clock.absent-and-json.why: Without it, a board that never ran a pass would print a broken line or machine readers would lose the document.
